excerpts.content:
wondering if something like this could work for PBS?

taking the idea of validator sync committee -> making a committee of validators who get assigned MEV relay duties/bundle acceptance duties
then to enable participation in MEV, change fee-recipient to a special address and submit signed blinded block like a normally submitted block
relay committees allow execution bundle auction process and then submits the highest bid bundle when auction time runs out

then can allow signed bundle submissions from registered addresses in a smart contract which have deposits to "slash" against bad behavior like spamming
rewards could then go here to this smart contract and claimable by the validator owner key/or something like that
